abstract: A series of 10 classical testicular seminomas and 10 intracranial germinomas were reviewed and examined using immunohistochemical techniques. In particular, the staining profiles of the tumour cells and the nature of the mononuclear cell infiltrate at the two sites were studied and compared. The tumour cells in eight of the 10 intracranial germinomas and nine of the 10 seminomas exhibited positive staining with placental alkaline phosphatase. Only one intracranial germinoma showed evidence of human chorionic gonadotrophin expression. Tumour cells in all cases at both sites were negative for cytokeratin and vimentin. The lymphocytic infiltrate in both the testicular and intracranial tumours was similar, comprising T-cells and B-cells, the former predominantly. The presence of macrophages and granulomas in tumours at both sites was noted. These findings confirm the high degree of similarity of germinomas of intracranial and testicular origin, and support the hypothesis of a common derivation. We could find no evidence of differentiation of tumour cells at either site.
abstract_ja: 精巣の古典的セミノーマ10例と頭蓋内胚腫10例を再検討し、免疫組織化学的手法を用いて比較した。特に両部位の腫瘍細胞の染色パターンと単核細胞浸潤の性質を検討した。胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼは頭蓋内胚腫10例中8例、精巣セミノーマ10例中9例で陽性であった。頭蓋内胚腫1例のみでヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンの発現を認めた。両部位の全例でサイトケラチンとビメンチンは陰性であった。精巣および頭蓋内の腫瘍のリンパ球浸潤は類似しており、T細胞が優位でB細胞も認められた。両部位ともマクロファージと肉芽腫の存在が認められた。これらの所見は、頭蓋内と精巣由来の胚腫の高い類似性を裏付け、共通の起源という仮説を支持する。いずれの部位でも腫瘍細胞の分化は認められなかった。
